Updated to games played in August 2018 == Presidential elections Protests 2019 == Immediately after the announcement of several parties in the social networking sites on the events of Friday, February 22 against the fifth term of the current President [[Abdelaziz Bouteflika]], [[Ligue de Football Professionnel (Algeria)|LFP]] announced the suspension of a match between [[MC Alger]] vs [[MC Oran]] for round 22 and [[JSM Bejaia]] vs [[Paradou AC]] in the [[2018–19 Algerian Cup|Algerian Cup]].{{cite web |url=http://www.dzfoot.com/2019/02/23/ligue-1-j22-mc-alger-mc-oran-reporte-aussi-145732.php |title=Ligue 1 (J22) : MC Alger - MC Oran reporté aussi |website=dzfoot.com |access-date=26 February 2019}} On 24 February 2019, The match between the [[CR Belouizdad]] vs [[DRB Tadjenanet]] were suspended, Which was to play on Tuesday, also has been delayed 3 games In addition, the matches [[USM Alger]] vs [[Paradou AC]] of Ligue 1 23rd day, [[US Biskra]] vs [[JSM Skikda]] and [[ASM Oran]] vs [[RC Relizane]] of Ligue 2 24th day, initially fixed for Friday 1 March are staggered to Saturday 2 March.{{cite web |url=http://www.dzfoot.com/2019/02/24/lfp-un-troisieme-match-reporte-dautres-decales-145873.php |title=LFP : Un troisième match reporté, d'autres décalés |website=dzfoot.com |access-date=26 February footballistique fortement perturbé |website=tsa-algerie.com |access-date=26 February 2019}} A day later, another match was suspended in the Ligue 1 between [[USM Bel Abbès]] and [[JS Saoura]], in Ligue 2 Also postponed another match [[ASO Chlef]] vs [[JSM Bejaia]].{{cite web |url=http://www.dzfoot.com/2019/02/25/lfp-troisieme-vague-de-reports-de-matchs-145899.php |title=LFP : Troisième vague
